description: Travel to a tile in the current lot. Prerequisite for interact-with on a distant object. Path is planned by the lot's authoritative VM; you may be blocked by walls, locked doors, or another Sim. On success you are at or within ~1 tile of the target; on failure a dialog may fire and you stop where blocked.

args.name: x
args.description: Target x in 1/16 tile units (from nearby_objects[].position.x)

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: ObjectID of a landmark to approach; takes precedence over x/y if set

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: PersistID of a nearby Sim to approach
